scope.description: Whole sqlite application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Relational schema/queries, transactions, updates, indexes, constraints, existing databases and engine management.

coverage.rationale: Useful relational preparation and aggregation cover a limited slice of a general SQL engine; updates and existing database work are absent.

scope.description: Fresh typed related tables to one foreign-key join/filter/group summary and database publication.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Typed tables, relations and grouped measures replace authored SQL, while users still select keys and closed relational operations.

limitations: One to four bounded fresh tables, one FK inner join and SUM/COUNT filter subset; no existing databases, arbitrary SQL, transactions or extensions.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
